scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve a same-day simulator telemetry trace before the untagged queue can make it unavailable for a pending stage-check evidence packet.
Emerging Need: The practice block and desk contact are harmless preliminaries until a completed Redbird session gains an instructor-selected evidence role while still sitting outside the archive manifest.
Decision Context: Stored packet and telemetry rules distinguish eligible selected traces from ordinary practice, identify the archive channel and allowed identifiers, and set the same-day intake boundary.
Consequence: Timely low-commitment archiving preserves usable evidence; waiting past manifest closure leaves the trace awaiting purge with no accepted route to recover it for the review.
